finding_metadata.title: External input controls a filesystem path
finding_metadata.description: External input from line 11 reaches a file operation without an observed path boundary.
finding_metadata.recommendation: Resolve the candidate and trusted root, reject paths outside that root using path-component containment, and avoid following untrusted symlinks.

finding_metadata.title: Untrusted archive reaches fully-trusted extraction
finding_metadata.description: The resolved extractor explicitly uses fully_trusted filtering. An observed external file object reaches the archive reader.
finding_metadata.recommendation: Use the data extraction filter and an isolated destination; also bound archive size and resource use.

finding_metadata.title: Archive extraction filter needs runtime/context review
finding_metadata.description: No unambiguous data filter is observed. Python 3.14+ changed the default to data; older runtimes, custom filters, member guards and archive trust need review. This is not a confirmed path-traversal finding.
finding_metadata.recommendation: Specify filter="data" where supported, confirm the target Python version, and review link handling and resource limits.
